entities.name: Crown Colony Rule Reimposed
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The British authorities, alarmed by Black political power, gradually eroded Dominican self-governance and reimposed direct Crown Colony rule by 1898, stripping away the representative institutions that had allowed Black political participation.
